item.title: My First Month Studying Abroad
item.summary: A student podcaster shares what surprised her in her first month at a university abroad, and what helped.
item.transcript_text: Hi everyone, and welcome back to the podcast. Today I want to talk honestly about my first month as a student abroad. When I arrived in Germany last September, I thought my English would be enough for everything. At the university it was, but in shops and offices I often felt lost. So I downloaded a language app and started learning ten German words every day. The second surprise was cooking. At home, my mother always cooked, and I had never made plov on my own. In the first week, I lived on bread and soup, which wasn't great. Then I called my mum, and she taught me her recipe over a video call. Now I cook for my flatmates every Sunday, and it's the best way I've found to make friends. The hardest part, to be honest, was feeling homesick in the evenings. What helped was having a routine, so I joined the university running club, which meets three times a week. My advice is simple: don't wait for life to feel normal; build small habits that make it normal. That's all for today, and see you next week.
